cases.question: 比较Q1和Q2各门店成交销额。
cases.generated_sql:
WITH q1 AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(so.quantity * so.sale_price - so.discount_amount) AS q1_sales_amount
  FROM sales_order AS so
  WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date < '2025-04-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
),
q2 AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(so.quantity * so.sale_price - so.discount_amount) AS q2_sales_amount
  FROM sales_order AS so
  WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND so.order_date < '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
)
SELECT
  si.store_id,
  si.store_name,
  COALESCE(q1.q1_sales_amount, 0) AS q1_sales_amount,
  COALESCE(q2.q2_sales_amount, 0) AS q2_sales_amount,
  COALESCE(q2.q2_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(q1.q1_sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount_change,
  (COALESCE(q2.q2_sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(q1.q1_sales_amount, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(q1.q1_sales_amount, 0), 0) AS sales_amount_growth_rate
FROM store_info AS si
LEFT JOIN q1 ON si.store_id = q1.store_id
LEFT JOIN q2 ON si.store_id = q2.store_id
WHERE q1.store_id IS NOT NULL OR q2.store_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sales_amount_change DESC, si.store_id;

cases.question: 找出Q2成交销额比Q1下降的门店。
cases.generated_sql:
WITH q1 AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(so.quantity * so.sale_price - so.discount_amount) AS q1_sales
  FROM sales_order AS so
  WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date < '2025-04-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
),
q2 AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(so.quantity * so.sale_price - so.discount_amount) AS q2_sales
  FROM sales_order AS so
  WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND so.order_date < '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
)
SELECT
  si.store_id,
  si.store_name,
  si.region,
  si.city,
  q1.q1_sales,
  q2.q2_sales,
  q2.q2_sales - q1.q1_sales AS sales_change,
  (q2.q2_sales - q1.q1_sales) / NULLIF(q1.q1_sales, 0) AS sales_change_rate
FROM q1
JOIN q2 ON q2.store_id = q1.store_id
JOIN store_info AS si ON si.store_id = q1.store_id
WHERE q2.q2_sales < q1.q1_sales
ORDER BY sales_change ASC;

cases.question: 2025年上半年各门店退损率是多少？
cases.generated_sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(so.quantity * so.sale_price - so.discount_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM sales_order AS so
  WHERE so.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND so.order_date < '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
), refunds AS (
  SELECT
    so.store_id,
    SUM(rr.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM refund_record AS rr
  JOIN sales_order AS so ON so.order_id = rr.order_id
  WHERE rr.refund_date >= '2025-01-01' AND rr.refund_date < '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY so.store_id
)
SELECT
  si.store_id,
  si.store_name,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount,
  COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount,
  COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM store_info AS si
LEFT JOIN sales AS s ON si.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON si.store_id = r.store_id
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, si.store_id;
